description: Interchange schema between hallthruster_bridge/run_cases.jl (producer, per operating point) and abep_sim/hall_map.py (consumer, gridded map). Both read this file; neither hard-codes field names. A field whose status is 'not_computed' has no producer yet: a point missing it is not map-ready, and it must never be filled with a placeholder.

meta_required.pinned: full text of hallthruster_bridge/PINNED.toml at generation time (must contain the pinned commit)
meta_required.hallthruster_commit: HallThruster.jl git rev actually installed (Manifest repo-rev)
meta_required.transport: anomalous-transport model and parameters used (string, e.g. 'TwoZoneBohm(1/160, 1/16), transition 0.1 L')
meta_required.facility_ingestion: bool; flight (space) maps must be false
meta_required.ion_wall_losses: bool; true only if ion wall losses were removed from the ion fluid in the solve (HallThruster.jl Config.ion_wall_losses). With false, wall_ion_flux_m2s/wall_ion_energy_eV are diagnostic, not erosion-grade
meta_required.ensemble_member_id: id of the transport-ensemble member (hallthruster_bridge/ensemble/transport_ensemble_v0.json) that produced this map; HallMap rejects ids not in the ensemble. Calibration-nuisance variables (P5 registration, coil shape, beam reading) are never map axes

conventions.note: sustained_min_Id_fraction is a bookkeeping convention (discharge treated as extinguished if I_d falls below 1 % of its window mean), not a physical validation criterion. Oscillation acceptability is judged from Id_rms_rel, Id_pp_rel and Id_f_dominant_Hz against measurements.

thrust_N.definition: time-averaged ion momentum flux through the domain exit minus anode (HallThruster.thrust)

discharge_current_A.definition: time-averaged discharge current over the averaging window

ion_current_A.definition: time-averaged ion current at the domain exit (HallThruster.ion_current)

Te_max_eV.definition: maximum of the time-averaged electron temperature profile

ne_max_m3.definition: maximum of the time-averaged plasma density profile

ion_species_fraction_atomic.definition: fraction of the time-averaged exit ion number flux carried by ions of single-atom species (1.0 for Xe by definition)

wall_ion_flux_m2s.definition: channel-averaged (z <= L) Bohm ion flux per unit wall area from HallThruster.jl's WallSheath model, loss_scale * h * sum_s n_s sqrt(Z_s e T_e / m_s), evaluated per saved frame in the averaging window and time-averaged. With ion_wall_losses=false (see wall_ion_basis) it sets the electron wall loss but is not removed from the ion fluid. Absent for other wall models or shielded thrusters.

wall_ion_energy_eV.definition: flux-weighted mean ion impact energy Z phi_s + T_e/2 (WallSheath sheath potential with space-charge-limited SEE yield, plus Bohm presheath), same evaluation as wall_ion_flux_m2s. Excludes the axial ion kinetic energy.

Id_rms_rel.definition: RMS of I_d over the averaging window / mean

Id_pp_rel.definition: (max - min) of I_d over the averaging window / mean

Id_f_dominant_Hz.definition: frequency of the largest DFT amplitude of the mean-removed I_d window (resolution 1/window length)

converged.definition: solver returned retcode :success (reached duration, no NaN/Inf)

sustained.definition: converged and min I_d over the window > sustained_min_Id_fraction * mean

wall_life_trustworthy.definition: converged AND sustained AND ion_wall_losses=true AND wall model is WallSheath AND unshielded AND both wall fields present. map_ready means schema-complete only; lifetime/erosion use requires wall_life_trustworthy
